_comment: USER-FOUND, 2026-09-03 (play viewer, EldraziDisplacerFlicker seed 1 turn 3): the engine offered
Mariposa Military Base's '{5}, {T}: Draw a card' on a board that could not pay for it, and
choosing it did NOTHING -- library unchanged, Mariposa still untapped, and the plan still in the
menu, so the main phase re-prompted on it until the seg < 64 cap.
THE CAUSE: '{T}' is part of the cost, so a source that also taps for mana cannot fund its own
ability. AvailableManaPool counts every untapped source including this one, so the ability
priced as payable off its own mana. On the real board the pool held exactly 5 -- Aether Hub's
{C}{G}{G}, Mariposa's own {C}, and the Trace of Abundance riding ON Mariposa -- against a {5}
cost. Tapping Mariposa removes BOTH of its mana and leaves 3.
The APPLY was never wrong: AIEngine taps the source first, then pays, then untaps on failure.
That is exactly why the symptom was silent. See PermAbilityTapDebitOf in TurnSolver.cpp.
ALL FOUR cards carrying a '{cost}, {T}' ability today are mana sources whose own yield covers
part of the cost, so all four were affected: Mariposa ({5} draw), Shivan Gorge ({2}{R} ping),
Conservatory and Kitchen ({4} Investigate). SHIVAN GORGE is why this is a correctness fix and
not a tempo one -- it is EldraziDisplacerFlicker's lethal outlet, so an over-claimed activation
is over-claimed DAMAGE: the [fd-diverge] shape where the search projects a kill the game never
deals.
THIS FIXTURE is the negative half. Mariposa + 4 Forests = a pool of 5 against a {5} cost, so it
reads affordable to a pool that counts Mariposa and is unpayable to one that does not. Its twin
tap_ability_self_funding_payable.json adds a fifth Forest and must still verdict `accept` -- the
pair brackets the boundary, which is what catches an over-tight fix as well as a missing one.
Verified DISCRIMINATING: with MTG_TAP_ABILITY_DEBIT=0 this fixture verdicts `accept` (the bug),
with the fix it verdicts `illegal`. The REASON matters as much as the verdict here: before the
matching CheckLine change this line came back `legal_not_enumerated`, i.e. the viewer told the
user the search had a reachability bug when the line simply could not be paid for. CheckLine
had charged battlefield activations nothing at all, on a stale assumption that every ability
reached through the `cast=` verb is free.
